question: The income of a company increases 30% per year. If its income is Rs. 70,98,000 in the year 2018, then the income in 2016 was:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Let the income in 2016 be x,

The income increased per year = 30% = (100 + 30)/100 = 130/100

⇒ x × 130/100 × 130/100 = 70,98,000

⇒ x = **Rs. 42,00,000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Calculation:**

Let the income of company in the year 2016 be 100.

Income of the company in the year 2018 = 100 × (1 + 30over100)² =169

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af0c5ca12f3f3466b2d69f017789df9232349d26d89f9748d4c42348c68a2394.png] 

⇒ x = 70,98,000× 100over169 = Rs 42,00,000

**∴ The income of the company in the year 2016 was Rs. 42,00,000 **
